**Image 1:**
(1) **Page:** "Keamanan & Akses" (Security & Access) > Tab **"Kebijakan Kata Sandi"** (Password Policy).  
(2) **State:** Real loaded data (configuration form).  
(3) **Content:** Form fields for password complexity (Min/Max length 8/64, Min unique chars 4, Max consecutive same/diff chars 3), toggles for uppercase, lowercase, digits, special chars, and restrictions on username/email/common passwords. Right panel shows a "Uji Coba Sandi" (Test Password) tool with sample user "Dewi Lestari".  
(4) **Overlays:** None visible.

**Image 2:**
(1) **Page:** "Keamanan & Akses" (Security & Access) > Tab **"Hak Akses per Pengguna"** (User Access Rights).  
(2) **State:** Real loaded data.  
(3) **Content:** Summary cards showing 6 Users, 4 Restricted Menus, 2 User Data Rules, 2 Super Admins. Below is a user list (left) with "Tri Handayani" selected as OWNER/Super Admin, and a detail panel (right) showing her permissions (auto Super Admin, full menu/data access).  
(4) **Overlays:** None visible.

**Image 3:**
(1) **Page:** "Keamanan & Akses" (Security & Access) > Tab **"Pengguna"** (Users).  
(2) **State:** Real loaded data table.  
(3) **Content:** Table of 6 application users (Agus Salim, Bambang Prakoso, Hartono Wijksono, Joko Susilo, Sri Wahyuni, Tri Handayani) with columns for Role (Viewer/Approver/Admin/OWNER), Last Login, Password Expiry (mostly "Berlaku 90 hari lagi"), and Status (Aktif).  
(4) **Overlays:** None visible.

**Image 4:**
(1) **Page:** **"Log Aktivitas"** (Activity Log) under the System Configuration menu.  
(2) **State:** Skeleton/loading state (placeholder blocks).  
(3) **Content:** Page header with filters (Advance Search, All Actions/Entities/Employees, Date Range) and an "Export CSV" button. The main content area shows ~7 light blue rectangular skeleton placeholders where the log entries should load.  
(4) **Overlays:** None visible.
